Concentrations from closed-form solutions

Source: R/closed_form.R
pk_conc.Rd

Central-compartment concentrations of a linear 1- or 2-compartment model, summed over doses. These are the same solutions used in the Stan model.

Usage

pk_conc(
  times,
  doses,
  par,
  structure = c("1cmt", "2cmt"),
  route = c("iv", "oral")
)

Arguments

times

Observation times.

doses

Data frame with time, amt and optionally rate (0 for bolus or oral doses), as returned by dose_regimen().

par

Named numeric vector of parameters (CL, V or CL, V1, Q, V2, and KA for oral).

structure

"1cmt" or "2cmt".

route

"iv" or "oral".

Value

Numeric vector of concentrations at times.

Examples

pk_conc(0:24, dose_regimen(100), c(CL = 5, V = 50, KA = 1), "1cmt", "oral")
#>  [1] 0.0000000 1.1932399 1.5186566 1.5356248 1.4488987 1.3328727 1.2140731
#>  [8] 1.1014965 0.9977633 0.9032139 0.8174090 0.7396764 0.6693068 0.6056212
#> [15] 0.5479914 0.4958441 0.4486587 0.4059633 0.3673308 0.3323747 0.3007451
#> [22] 0.2721254 0.2462292 0.2227974 0.2015955
